description: Rebuild a CDC (Change Data Capture) pipeline that has fallen behind by 48 hours. Must: identify the replication lag cause (consumer outage), capture current WAL position, replay missed changes from WAL archive, verify data parity between source and target, and cutover consumers back to real-time CDC stream. Risk factors: WAL archive gaps, replay causing duplicate events, parity check timing out on large datasets, cutover gap missing events. Tools available: Debezium, Kafka, wal-g, Snowflake, psql.
